notes: Phase B removal may start only after BOTH boundaries hold: at least minimum_window_days days have elapsed since publication_utc_date, and at least minimum_subsequent_minor_releases subsequent minor releases have been published. earliest_removal_utc_date records the later of the publication date plus minimum_window_days and every published subsequent-minor-release date; while the subsequent minor release is unpublished this field is the day-count floor and the release boundary is still unsatisfied. When v0.2.0 is actually tagged, the maintainer updates publication_status, publication_utc_date, and earliest_removal_utc_date in the same commit as the tag (see docs/releasing.md).
